hook: auspicious／propitious 是晴空賀詞，ominous 是烏雲警報——氣象主播拿兩支麥克風：吉與凶。
script: auspicious＝吉利的。propitious＝有利／適合的。ominous＝兇兆的。口令：晴空寫開工，烏雲寫快跑。形近對決：先分清語意軸，再對號入座。登場：auspicious（晴空麥）、propitious（順風標）、ominous（烏雲警）、favorable（綠燈）、inauspicious（黑貓標）、sunshine（陽光）。

members.speakLineEn: Clear skies on opening day felt auspicious for the outdoor festival.
members.speakLineZh: 開幕當天晴空萬里，對戶外慶典來說顯得吉祥有利。

members.speakLineEn: A propitious breeze filled the sails just as the race began.
members.speakLineZh: 比賽一開始，一陣吉祥的風正好鼓起船帆。

members.speakLineEn: Dark clouds and distant thunder created an ominous mood over the valley.
members.speakLineZh: 烏雲與遠方雷聲，讓山谷籠罩在凶兆的氣氛中。

related.synonyms: baleful, forbidding, menacing, minacious, minatory, sinister

members.speakLineEn: Reviewers gave the new library a favorable report on lighting and space.
members.speakLineZh: 評論者對新圖書館的照明與空間給予有利的評價。

members.speakLineEn: Losing the first match was an inauspicious start to the tournament.
members.speakLineZh: 輸掉第一場比賽，對這次錦標賽來說是不吉利的開局。

members.speakLineEn: Morning sunshine poured through the classroom windows after the storm.
members.speakLineZh: 暴風雨過後，早晨的陽光從教室窗戶灑進來。

members.speakLineEn: The host tapped the mic twice before welcoming the audience on stage.
members.speakLineZh: 主持人輕拍兩下麥克風，才上台向觀眾致意。

members.speakLineEn: They felt lucky to catch the last train before the station closed.
members.speakLineZh: 他們趕上車站關閉前的末班車，覺得自己很幸運。

members.speakLineEn: Guests checked in at the hotel desk and received maps of the city.
members.speakLineZh: 旅客在飯店櫃台辦理入住，並拿到市區地圖。

pitfalls: 吉利≠兇兆，先看天色再寫句
